methodologyNotes: Covers standalone LED desk and task lamps sold at a published US MSRP, including freestanding-base, clamp-mount, and monitor-mounted light bars marketed as desk task lighting. Excludes floor lamps, ring lights sold as photography/streaming gear, smart bulbs, and under-cabinet strips. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. brightnessLumens is peak luminous flux in lumens at the highest setting (null if the manufacturer publishes only lux-at-distance and no lumen figure). colorTempRangeKelvin is the tunable correlated color temperature range in Kelvin as a 'low-high' string, a single value if the lamp is fixed-CCT, or null if not disclosed. cri is the Color Rendering Index (Ra) on the 0-100 scale, higher is better; null if not disclosed. brightnessLevels is the count of discrete dimming steps as an integer, or 'stepless' if continuously dimmable. colorTempSettings is the count of selectable white-temperature modes as an integer, or 'stepless' if continuously tunable; 1 if fixed. powerWatts is rated electrical power draw in watts. powerSource is an enum: 'corded', 'rechargeable', or 'corded-or-rechargeable'. mountType is an enum: 'base', 'clamp', 'base-or-clamp', or 'monitor-mount'. usbChargingPort is a boolean for a built-in USB output port for charging devices. wirelessCharging is a boolean for an integrated Qi wireless charging pad. autoDimmingSensor is a boolean for an ambient-light or occupancy sensor that auto-adjusts brightness. weightGrams is product weight in grams.

The BenQ manufacturer page's price field did not render (JavaScript placeholder), so the $179 US figure is sourced from the dated review (and is consistent with contemporaneous retailer listings for this exact model).
products.provenance: The BenQ US manufacturer page confirms the exact ScreenBar Halo model via its spec comparison table (Halo column: 63cm x 40cm coverage at 500 lux, flat 0.7-6cm / curved 1.6-3.8cm compatibility matching the Halo body text, 5V/max 1.3A USB), and states 2700K-6500K stepless brightness/color-temperature, Ra>95 CRI, a built-in ambient sensor with real-time auto-dimming to 500 lux, and USB (corded) power. The Minimal Desk Setups hands-on review (dated Feb 1, 2022) corroborates the exact "Screenbar Halo Monitor Light" model, listing RATED POWER 6.5W and COLOR TEMPERATURE 2700-6500K, and reports BenQ indicated the price "will be around $179 USD." Brightness is published only as lux-at-distance (800 lux center) with no lumen figure, and neither page discloses product weight, so both are null per methodology.

TechRadar's dated review (published 3 Nov 2023, "Dyson Solarcycle Morph Desk") independently corroborated the same DESK model (not the taller/heavier floor version) with matching 850 lumen, CRI 90, USB-C port, auto-brightness sensor, and weight "7.7lb / 3.5kg", and states it "retails for $649.99" — establishing $649.99 as the US MSRP. Both pages confirm this is the desk (CD06) variant, distinct from the floor lamp (1,252 mm / 6 kg).
